uiDefinition.description: The endpoint of the Foundry resource that hosts the deployment, for example https://my-resource.services.ai.azure.com.
uiDefinition.tooltip: Copy the endpoint from the deployment details page in the Foundry portal. Only the scheme and host are used, so a target URI that includes a path also works.

uiDefinition.description: The name of your Microsoft-Decision-1 deployment, for example Decision-1.
uiDefinition.tooltip: The deployment name, not the model name. Create a separate connection to use another deployment.

uiDefinition.description: An API key of the Foundry resource.
uiDefinition.tooltip: Copy Key 1 or Key 2 from the deployment details page or the resource's Keys and Endpoint page. The connector sends it in the api-key header.
